review.basis: Independent solve: the discriminating smear clue is the teardrop cell, which Current H3 KP17 maps to myelofibrosis rather than the hemolytic-anemia pattern; target cells are mapped to thalassemia. Independent post-target cross-check against H5 confirms nucleated RBCs as marrow compensation in hemolysis and fragmented RBCs as RBC-damage evidence, so teardrop cells are the tested non-hemolytic choice.
